name: LCD1602 (HD44780)
description: A character LCD of 16 columns and 2 rows of 5 x 8 dots, with an HD44780 controller, on its 16-pin header: VSS, VDD, V0 (contrast), RS, R/W, E, D0 to D7, and A and K for the LED backlight. The controller takes D0-D7 at the falling edge of E, or D4-D7 twice in 4-bit mode; with R/W high it drives the bus while E is high (busy flag and address counter, or the character at the address counter). An instruction takes 37 µs, a clear or a return home 1.52 ms, the internal reset 10 ms after power on: a write while the controller is busy is lost and counted (early), and so is an E pulse shorter than 230 ns or closer than 500 ns to the previous one (timing). The text is visible when VDD - V0 is above 3 V (contrast); the backlight lights when A is above K by more than 2.6 V. The module draws no current from the circuit.

color.description: Dark characters on a yellow-green panel, or white characters on a blue one.

footprint.description: The 16 pins of the header, 2.54 mm apart, in one row.

powered.description: VDD is at least 2.7 V above VSS.

contrast.description: How dark the dots that are on look: 0 below 3 V between VDD and V0 or with V0 unconnected, 1 from 4.5 V.

backlight.description: Brightness of the backlight, from the voltage between A and K.

displayOn.description: The display is on (display control D).

cursor.description: The underline cursor is shown (display control C).

blink.description: The character at the cursor blinks (display control B).

dataBits.description: Width of the interface: 8, or 4 after a function set with DL clear.

lines.description: Display lines of the function set: 1 after power on, 2 with N set.

dataWrites.description: Characters or CGRAM rows written since power on.

reads.description: Reads of the busy flag or of the memory.

early.description: Writes lost because the controller was still busy, and memory reads while it was.

timing.description: E pulses shorter than 230 ns, or less than 500 ns after the previous one.

revision.description: Increases whenever what the panel shows may have changed.
